To counteract these challenges, embracing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-costing-you-2|crypto]]currency as a payment method is not just beneficial; it's essential. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online without reliance on platforms like PayPal or Stripe means leveraging cryptocurrency for transactions. This approach not only reduces fees but also increases financial sovereignty. For example, while Gumroad takes a hefty 10% cut on sales, using NOWPayments allows you to retain 99.5% of your earnings. This financial empowerment is crucial for artists, especially in areas where economic instability makes conventional banking unreliable.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure to sell music and accept Bitcoin involves several key components working in tandem. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend automation, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you create a seamless experience for buyers. The order processing occurs automatically once payment is confirmed on-chain, ensuring instant delivery of your music. This architecture not only minimizes costs but also eliminates third-party dependencies, giving you full control over your sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for independent musicians and digital creators operating in regions where traditional payment processors are inaccessible. Artists in Nigeria, Kenya, and Zimbabwe can now set up their online stores without the fear of currency collapse or payment rejection. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you empower yourself to sell directly to your audience, ensuring that every transaction is secure and efficient.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, allowing you to keep more of your hard-earned income.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your storefront, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for handling backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. These elements work together to create a robust system for managing your digital products. Using tools such as Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you maintain full data ownership while ensuring quick and easy access to your sales metrics.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your music online using this infrastructure, first, choose a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and ensure your music files are stored securely in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. Finally, test the entire setup before launching to ensure a smooth experience for your customers.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. These platforms enable you to sell digital products while avoiding high platform fees, giving you more control over your revenue. By building a sovereign commerce stack, you can create an automated and efficient sales process that works for you.
By owning your infrastructure, you maintain full control over your sales and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
